summary: Backend-only independent verification of the Rapid Fire fixes. (1) Cup Night seat flag — ran the 5 cup suites three times back-to-back; runs 2 and 3 were fully green (13/13 passed). Run 1 had ONE transient failure in test_iter66_crown_guard_lead::test_night_guard_create_and_join: the POST /api/rf/cups (open) call inside the guard window returned 503 'The arena is packed right now … arena_busy' instead of 409 'Cup Night … in a few minutes', so the assertion fired. The 503 is from the global arena-busy load-guard (not the Cup Night fix), was not reproducible on reruns, and disappears when the heavy test_iter73_scale load tails off. Cup Night seat flag itself works: join -> joined=true, GET night keeps joined=true, leave -> joined=false in every passed run. (2) XP leaderboard — test_xp_ladder_ranks.py: 2 passed in 64s; your.rank matches the plain count + overtake refreshes after the 31 s stale window. (3) All India Rapid board — test_daily_board_ranks.py + test_rf_daily.py + test_rf_daily_pcm45.py: 8 passed in 149s; places equal sort order, players == finished runs. (4) Smoke through the public API with a TEST-* grant using perf_rf_probe.py: every one of 24 GETs/POSTs returned 200 (catalog/profile/inbox/history/revision/weak-topics/duels/duels-live/cups/cups-night/cups-champions/badla/feed/shop/friends/gangs/leaderboard/daily and the full solo-session + practice-rival-bot flow). Server p50 stays <= 1.6 ms except catalog (first-load JIT 29.9 ms) and sessions-create (24 ms, which is the card-pool lock). (5) Full regression (one 11m12s run, '-n 2 --dist loadscope', as configured): 576 passed, 70 skipped, 1 failed (test_rf_shop_bot.py::TestBotDuel::test_bot_duel_full). This is a known flake, not a regression of the targeted fixes: when I re-ran test_rf_shop_bot.py three times in isolation the whole file passed 8/8 each time; the failing assertion is 'bot must stay below human' and in the one failing run the bot catch-up at the finish line put the bot at 14 vs the human's 3 because the test always picks index 0 and gets only 3 right over 30 cards. The code path is unchanged by the fixes under review. (6) /app/backend/tools/db_audit.py check on the scratch DB: 56 XP-board players, 73 All India Rapid runs on 2026-11-20 out of 30,002, 7 weak-chapter students — ended with 'ALL THE SAME'. No real 500s in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — the only Traceback is a benign starlette ClientDisconnect in the /api/jl proxy, left over from an earlier session.

minor.issue: Flaky under parallel load — on 1 of 3 back-to-back cup-suite runs POST /api/rf/cups returned 503 arena_busy inside the Cup Night guard window, so the assertion 'status_code == 409 and "Cup Night" in detail' tripped. Re-runs green. This is load_guard arena-busy, NOT the Cup Night seat fix; consider a short backoff-retry in the test around '/cups' creation when 503 arena_busy is returned, or wait briefly after the preceding scale-heavy test finishes.

Flaky in the full-suite run under xdist loadscope (1/1 fail in today's single 11m regression). The test picks choice 0 every time, scores ~3/30 as the human and then asserts 'bot score < human score' at i=29 when the match is already finished; the bot's finish-line scoring put it at 14 and failed the assertion. Passed 8/8 when the file is run in isolation three times. Not caused by the fixes under review; recommend tightening the test (either answer with the server's revealed correct choice after each card or relax the final-card assertion when both scores are low).

action_items: Decide whether to classify test_iter66_crown_guard_lead::test_night_guard_create_and_join as cross-test flaky (arena_busy 503 bleeding in from the scale suite) and either retry POST /api/rf/cups on 503 arena_busy inside this test or serialize it after test_iter73_scale via conftest's one_at_a_time lock.

Decide whether to tighten tests/test_rf_shop_bot.py::TestBotDuel::test_bot_duel_full — either learn the correct choice from each /answer response (so the human's end score is realistic) or relax the final-card 'bot < human' assertion when the human's score is <=3/30.

No change needed to cups.py night() (seat flag), gamify.py ladder/build_ladder/leaderboard, or daily.py board/rank_of/add_to_board — the three targeted fixes are verified green by the dedicated suites.
critical_code_review_comments: cups.py night() seat flag — verified by 3 back-to-back passes of the 5-file cup bundle (except the unrelated arena_busy flake above); the 1.2 s wait + file lock added to conftest reliably prevents the previous race between workers.
gamify.py XP ladder — build_ladder()+ladder()+leaderboard() hold up under the 65-second scenario in test_xp_ladder_ranks (overtake + 31 s stale invalidation).
daily.py All India Rapid board — plain-order ranking and finished-run player count are correct across 2.5 minutes of tests at 30,002 runs for today.
